description: This PHP source file defines the I18NImportErrorAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It extends functionality to provide an API endpoint for listing internationalization (i18n) import errors, including handling request parameters, validation, and response formatting. The class uses traits for authentication and localization services and interacts with a DAO for data retrieval.
